Your current Google Apps Script website handles RSVPs, but it doesn't reliably support the custom image previews used by iMessage and other texting apps.

  3. Link that page to your existing RSVP website.

We can use free hosting, so you shouldn't need to pay for anything. The preview's appearance will depend on the recipient's messaging app.

One question: Would you like the invitation to look more cute and playful (illustrated turkeys, pumpkins, pies) or chic and festive (beautiful fall colors, elegant lettering, illustrated leaves and pumpkins)?

Step 3: Upload your invitation photo

First, save the invitation photo to your computer:

Download your Friendsgiving invitation

Then, on GitHub:

  1. Open your new friendsgiving-2026 repository.

  2. Click Add file near the top of the file list.

  3. Select Upload files.

  4. Drag your downloaded invitation photo into the upload area, or click choose your files.

  5. Scroll down and click Commit changes.

That's it for this step!

Once you've uploaded the photo, tell me "ready", and I'll help you create the actual clickable invitation webpage that connects to your RSVP and potluck sign-up. 🧡
